description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans configuration utilities, specifically testing the redaction of sensitive information such as connection strings for Azure Storage and SQL Server to prevent exposure of credentials in logs.

classes.name: ConfigTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Orleans configuration utilities focusing on security and redaction of sensitive connection string information.

methods.name: Config_AzureConnectionInfo
methods.description: Test method verifying that Azure Storage connection strings have their account keys properly redacted.

methods.name: Config_AdoNetConnectionInfo
methods.description: Test method verifying that SQL Server connection strings have their passwords properly redacted.
